newsitem.title: ISRAEL: BOXING-FLOAT LIKE A BUTTERLY, SOOTHE LIKE A BEE?.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-FLOAT LIKE A BUTTERLY, SOOTHE LIKE A BEE?.

text.p: Israeli beekeepers hope to take the sting out of heavyweight boxing champion Evander Holyfield's fight with Mike Tyson on Saturday.

The apiary at Kibbutz Yad Mordechai, a collective farm in southern Israel, said on Wednesday it had sent Holyfield a natural antibiotic cream which is produced by bees for the treatment of any cuts he might suffer in the Las Vegas bout.
The beekeepers said in an accompanying letter to Holyfield that they were supporting him.
"If we succeed even a little to ease and expedite treatment for the inevitable effects of the battle, we will feel as if we were partners in your success," the letter said.
